info.title: Ravn control plane
info.description: Ingests agent events, persists them, and serves the portal.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (1–500, default 50).

get.summary: Liveness probe — the process is up and serving.
Readiness probe — the process can serve real traffic.

status.description: Always `"ok"` when the service is live.

version.description: Build version of the control plane.

checks.description:
Per-dependency readiness (e.g. database, NATS), populated as those
dependencies are wired in (#24).

ready.description: Whether the service is ready to accept traffic.

StoredEvent.description:
A persisted event as returned by the read API.

Normalized columns are surfaced directly; `payload` and `explanation` are
the raw JSON forms of the `ravn-core` types.

explanation.description: LLM explanation (`ravn_core::Explanation`) as JSON, if present.

received_at.description: When the control plane ingested it.
